reviews.review: Bought it during the Black Friday sale. For $10 it's a good game.
Very Nice Game...cant stop playing it....so far

I started playing this game with an open mind and really wanting to enjoy it, but quite quickly I decided to stop playing it and just watch the rest of it as a movie on YouTube. There isn’t *one* big problem with the game, but rather everything is a little broken, boring, or just bad. There is one exception - I did like the graphics and I do enjoy HDR in games.

There is a lot of busy work that will get very repetitive, fast. The cover-based combat, in its current form, is dated and makes the “levels” look unnatural most of the time. The art style is hit (main villains) or miss. The characters are like bad actors with peculiar facial expressions and lines from B movies. The story has a very cool premise but ends up having a lot of plot holes and nonsensical parts.

 Rating: If they did not bother to finish the game then why should I?

Best Space exploration FPS, puzzle, story game out there.

Wonky. Ugly. Uncanny. Unintuitive. Infuriating.

I gave this game the benefit of doubt, and I was wrong to do it.

Bad combat. Bad animations. Bad level design and confusing geography. Bad AI. Bad quests. Bad deus-ex-machina. Bad story. Bad interface. Bad map. Bad quest trackers. 

Ridiculous ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ like: 
-High RPM, yet single-fire only "Assault Rifles"
-Being on your own because your team is stuck in a doorway
-Not being able to interact with your environment
-Getting shot by enemies that clipped through terrain
-Getting killed by the developer console opening
-Not being able to disable developer console
-Endless sitting through load screens (with tail animations after skipping) when changing locations to progress a quest, at least 2 to 5 of them could be skipped (galaxy view, system view, planet view, docking location, fast travel point)
-^all that but just to talk and trigger dialogue with someone in your team

If this game was play tested the developers probably didn't listen or care, but it was probably just rushed out before someone had the chance to complain. It's like someone who never developed or played a videogame, heard someone describe what games like Crysis and Mass Effect are like, and then tried to develop it with a rag-tag team or diversity hires.

I've seen medieval illustrations of elephants better executed.

This is not a bad mass effects game, it's a bad game where everyone involved in this project managed to do their job wrong, wasted millions and got their studio shut down.

One thing ME:Andromeda got right, is this single line of dialogue:
"Authoritarianism is a crutch for the incompetent."
